name: Community Compute and Dharma Exchange
description: Dharma economic model, contribution eligibility, idle resource advertisement, compute offer and request protocol, workload classification, trusted execution boundaries, privacy-preserving input packaging, result verification, redundant execution, malicious contributor detection, resource quotas, favor accrual and spending, expiry and decay policy, community capacity marketplace, geographic and jurisdiction controls, user consent, abuse response, and community compute simulation.
objective: Build the community compute marketplace and Dharma exchange for decentralized, trust-verified compute contributions.
